ROW.COLUMN: One method of laundering money through insurance products is to initiate a large policy with "dirty" money and then soon thereafter (within two years) terminate the policy and receive funds back from the insurance company. Surrendered or cancelled policies that do not meet amount thresholds on their own are of interest if the same customer is cancelling multiple smaller policies.
